# srd-masum-r35b

Live at https://srd-masum-r35b.folkapps.com. Vite + React + Tailwind, compiled and deployed as a static bundle by folk after your session exits. The global rules in `~/.config/opencode/AGENTS.md` apply here too.

Only a `create_or_edit_app` run publishes. Editing, building or committing these files from a terminal never changes the live site.

## Data

No database. Persist with `localStorage` (JSON.parse/stringify for complex objects). Forms use `mailto:`, an external form service, or a confirmation state — there is no backend.

<!-- folk:managed:end -->

## Design contract

<!-- Owned by the build, not by folk. Later edits read this to stay on-system,
     so be specific: a vague contract guarantees drift. -->

**Theme.** Dark is the default. A sun/moon icon button in the nav toggles to a light theme (`html.light`); the choice is stored in `localStorage` under `srd-theme` and applied by an inline script in `index.html` before first paint. Neutral tokens are CSS variables (`--canvas`, `--raised`, `--sunk`, `--hairline`, `--ink`, `--muted`, `--faint`) defined in `src/index.css`, so Tailwind classes like `bg-canvas` follow the theme. The accent `#0b6cf0` (royal blue, with `#0a3d91` and `#0a2a6b` deep shades and white highlights) stays the same in both themes; text on accent uses `text-on-accent` (`#0e0d0c`). Light values: canvas `#faf8f5`, raised `#ffffff`, sunk `#f0ede8`, hairline `#e0dbd4`, ink `#161411`, muted `#5c5751`.

**Tokens (dark).** Canvas `#0e0d0c` (page), raised `#171614` (contact panel), sunk `#1f1d1b` (nav pill, footer, players), hairline `#2c2a27`, ink `#f4f1ea`, muted `#a39e98`, the single accent `#0b6cf0` (CTAs, links, focus, the record mark). Display: Archivo Black (`@fontsource/archivo-black`, tracking -0.04em). Body: DM Sans 400/500/700 (`@fontsource/dm-sans`). Utility: IBM Plex Mono 400/500 for eyebrows (`@fontsource/ibm-plex-mono`). Layout: single column, max-w-6xl, sections separated by hairline rules, 16:9 YouTube embeds. The Videos section is a swipeable carousel (touch swipe and mouse drag, scroll-snap per card, layoutId dot indicators below); other sections use responsive grids. Signature element: the hero's oversized name typed out letter by letter once after the intro loader (`Typewriter` in `App.jsx`, blinking accent caret, full text set in an sr-only span), over a dimmed hero photograph (`/images/hero-portrait.jpg`, object-top) under a canvas-tinted vertical gradient overlay (`from-canvas/60 via-canvas/75 to-canvas/95`). This gradient is the one deliberate exception to the no-gradients rule. The Spotify "Follow on Spotify" button is the other exception: brand-mandated Spotify green `#1DB954`. The New Release countdown target is the `RELEASE_DATE` constant at the top of `App.jsx`; footer social links come from `SOCIAL_LINKS` in `src/data/videos.js`. Nav logo: a round pixel-art avatar (`/images/avatar.jpg`, 34px, accent ring) followed by the "SRD Masum" wordmark. The favicon is also `/images/avatar.jpg`.

**Simplicity.** Up front: the name, tagline, the featured player, the video grid and the email. Nothing is behind a menu. The only transient surface is the contact "Copy email" button, which changes its own label in place (no tray). No trays exist yet; any future overlay should be a bottom sheet on mobile and a centered dialog above `sm`, opening from the button that triggered it.

**Fluidity.** Shared spring: `{ type: "spring", stiffness: 260, damping: 30, mass: 0.9 }`, exported from `src/components/Reveal.jsx`. `layoutId="nav-pill"` in `src/components/Nav.jsx` travels between the three section links as scroll-spy moves the active state. Hero name types in (see Signature element). Sparkles (`src/components/Sparkles.jsx`) drift over the hero photo.  Section headings carry no glow underline, and the nav has no pulse line. Countdown tiles get a shine sweep (`.shine-tile`). Music notes rise from a playing track (`MusicNotes` in `SongPlayer.jsx`). Under reduced motion these are off or static on desktop pointers only; touch devices (`hover: none`) always run them. The check lives in `useDecorReduce` (`src/lib/motion.js`), and the CSS reduced-motion overrides are scoped to `(hover: hover)`. Section content reveals on scroll with `whileInView`. The "Copy email" label morphs via an AnimatePresence `popLayout` swap of the inner span (copy ↔ copied). Reduced motion: opacity-only entrances, no travel, no tap scale on the hero. The hero effects (aurora, orbs, vignette, hero glow, sparkles, snowfall) are the exception: they render and animate on every device, reduced motion included, with the same counts, transform and opacity only, and pause when the hero is offscreen or the tab is hidden. Fan Reviews (`src/components/Reviews.jsx`, between Press Kit and the Fan message form, nav link "Reviews"): an endless marquee of review cards (two identical copies, `.review-track` in `src/index.css`, pauses on desktop hover only; runs on touch devices and under reduced motion, since the owner wants the effect visible). Reviews persist in `localStorage` under `srd-reviews`, with seed reviews shown until something is saved. The "Leave a review" form (name, 1–5 star picker, message) appends to the marquee and saves; it shows an inline status line, not a tray.

**Delight.** Tier 1 (constant use): the nav pill glides between sections; buttons spring on press (scale 0.97). Tier 2: the video grid staggers in by column, the copy button springs and vibrates on copy. Tier 3 (rare, one moment): the hero name typing out on first load. Hidden surprise: none yet, keep it that way until a clear moment earns one. Idle hero: snow only. The aurora (`HeroAurora.jsx`), bokeh orbs, vignette, pink glow behind the photo (`HeroGlow.jsx`) and sparkles (`Sparkles.jsx`) are hidden until a track plays. Gentle snowfall runs at idle (`src/components/Snow.jsx`, soft pink/violet/amber flakes; fewer on phones; shows under reduced motion too). When a track plays, the aurora, orbs, vignette, glow and sparkles come back at full strength and the snow fades out. All of these stay transform and opacity only, no blur, no animated shadows. Pauses when the hero is offscreen or the tab is hidden.

Song lists (Hindi Songs, Bangla Songs): compact rows (`TrackRow` in `src/components/MiniPlayer.jsx`) with a small thumb, title, duration and a small play button, no per-row seek bar. Rows mount lazily when they near the viewport. One shared `<audio>` (`PlayerProvider`) drives everything, and a sticky `MiniPlayer` bar at the bottom of the viewport holds the seek bar, previous/next, title and artwork. Only the active row carries the beat glow (`beat-card`, `beat-glow`).

Music visualizer: while the cover track in Songs plays, the full hero aurora (`HeroAurora.jsx`), bokeh orbs, vignette and a soft pink glow behind the hero photo (`src/components/HeroGlow.jsx`) come back. The glow swells with the bass, read from a shared Web Audio analyser (`src/lib/beat.js`). It stops on pause and is off under prefers-reduced-motion. On phones (`isLiteDevice()`), the aurora, orbs, vignette, hero glow and beat background keep running during playback (transform and opacity only, no blur, fewer orbs). Only sparkles, snow and the hero title sheen are cut. `--beat` updates at 30fps on touch, falls back to a gentle sine pulse when the analyser reads silent, and the loop pauses when the tab is hidden or the hero is offscreen; floating notes spawn at half rate. Desktop is unchanged. Keep confetti off this page; the page has no finishing moment.
